newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends with small gains in rangebound.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends with small gains in rangebound.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Small gains were posted at the close after a rangebound trading day. Initial prices fell on weak soyoil, pushing August down to 1,219 ringgit. But afternoon prices rose on expectation of higher May export. Aug support is 1,210 with resistance at 1,246 next week.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Moved in tandem with futures and some refiners covering was seen among nearby CPOs.
Traders said there was no follow-through support due to uncertainty over the outcome of the export data. "We will only know the data on Monday."

The trader had said: "Sentiment took a turn earlier. A weak soyoil had triggered off selling and profit-taking this morning." Falls in the soyoil futures in Chicago last night weakened prices in morning sessions.

Technically, the charts are likely to show a downward trend as August futures broke the 1,220 ringgit level. "It did have a "false break" to 1,219 ringgit but buying returned in the afternoon to push up August futures contract," the trader said.
Only small gains were posted, traders said Prices movements were limited as players mostly sidelined ahead of the weekend.
Turnover on the futures market was 1,472 lots.
Physical June (south) saw offers at 1,285 against bids at 1,280 with earlier trades done at 1,280. June (central) was offered at 1,275 against 1,270 and June (north) at 1,265 against 1,250.
For July (south) it was offered at 1,275 ringgit against bids of 1,270, and July (central) at 1,265 against 1,255.
August futures contract closed three ringgit up at 1,230 ringgit ($489.65) a tonne.
In refined products, June RBD palm oil was offered at $537.50, July at $532.50 and Aug/Sept at $530. Aug was traded at $525.
June RBD palm olein saw offers at $572.50, July at $570 and Aug/Sept at $565, and July/Aug/Sept at $567.50. July was traded at $570 and $567.50, while Aug was done at $565.
June RBD palm stearin was offered at $402.50 and June/July palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $272.50.
